description: Test vectors for the language guard every VoiceFlow app runs after tidy-up. check: a transcript (source, as captured, before spellings apply) and a tidy-up (output); the result must be drift (true/false), reason ("", translated, han-added, latin-added or swapped) and mixed (the source holds both Chinese and English). guard: tidy-up, drift check, one strict retry, then the speaker's own words with the tidy-up held back; answers are the model's replies in order (null: the call failed); the result is the text delivered, the text held back for "Use cleaned", the reason, and the calls made (false = normal, true = strict). The thresholds: 2 added words or characters in the other script; a share test (a quarter of each script kept) once there are 4 Chinese characters or 4 English words. Names are invented. Android runs them in DriftVectorsTest, VoiceFlow Desktop in drift-check.test.ts. Since VoiceFlow Desktop 0.9.14 and Android 0.8.4, a case may give words: the tidy-up's word list ({text, heardAs}; absent means none). A listed word the tidy-up wrote in place of one of its heard-as forms earns a credit, capped by what changed (the forms removed and the words added); that many forms and words are taken out of both texts, matched on the texts as they are (ASCII letters in any case, whole words at Latin letter or digit edges, longest first, no overlaps), before the check. Mixed is judged on the transcript as it was.

check.name: fillers removed in both languages
check.source: So, um, I talked to Febe and she's like, 那个，她说周末可能不来了, because, like, the trail is, you know, still flooded. I mean, 就是，我们可以, like, go to the lake instead? Maybe Sunday afternoon.
check.output: I talked to Febe and she's like, 她说周末可能不来了, because the trail is still flooded. 我们可以 go to the lake instead? Maybe Sunday afternoon.

check.name: the abandoned half of a self-correction dropped
check.source: Okay so, like, the flight to Pinewood is on Friday, 不对，是 Saturday morning, 因为 Friday 的票太贵了。And then, you know, 我们 can rent a car at the airport, 然后 drive to the hotel. 那个，你觉得 that works?
check.output: The flight to Pinewood is on Saturday morning，因为 Friday 的票太贵了。And then 我们 can rent a car at the airport，然后 drive to the hotel。你觉得 that works?

check.name: Chinese-led speech with fillers removed
check.source: 呃，那个，我今天下午要去 QBR meeting，就是，可能会 late 一点。Um, 你可以帮我 pick up the parcel 吗？然后，嗯，晚上我们 order pizza 吧。
check.output: 我今天下午要去 QBR meeting，可能会 late 一点。你可以帮我 pick up the parcel 吗？晚上我们 order pizza 吧。

check.name: English-only rewrites are never drift
check.source: Hey so, like, are you guys still down for dinner on Saturday? I think seven works? Or, no wait, seven thirty.
check.output: Hey, are you guys still down for dinner on Saturday? I think seven thirty works.

check.name: pure Chinese edited in Chinese (deleting)
check.source: 呃，那个，我们明天开会吧
check.output: 我们明天开会吧。

check.name: pure Chinese reworded in Chinese (adding characters)
check.source: 我们明天那个开会
check.output: 我们明天下午开会。

check.name: case and apostrophe variants are not additions
check.source: ok 我们 go, it’s fine 因为 the QBR moved
check.output: Okay, 我们 go. It's fine 因为 the QBR moved.

check.name: an English connector turned into Chinese
check.source: So, um, I talked to Febe and she's like, 那个，她说周末可能不来了, because, like, the trail is, you know, still flooded. I mean, 就是，我们可以, like, go to the lake instead? Maybe Sunday afternoon.
check.output: I talked to Febe and she's like, 她说周末可能不来了，因为 the trail is still flooded. 我们可以 go to the lake instead? Maybe Sunday afternoon.

check.name: a Chinese clause turned into English
check.source: So, um, I talked to Febe and she's like, 那个，她说周末可能不来了, because, like, the trail is, you know, still flooded. I mean, 就是，我们可以, like, go to the lake instead? Maybe Sunday afternoon.
check.output: I talked to Febe and she's like, 她说周末可能不来了, because the trail is still flooded. We can go to the lake instead? Maybe Sunday afternoon.

check.name: one word swapped across scripts
check.source: 那个，我觉得 we should 先 finish it, 因为 Milo 需要 it by Friday.
check.output: 我觉得 we should 先 finish it, because Milo 需要 it by Friday.

check.name: English speech translated into Chinese
check.source: Can you ask Milo to add milk and eggs to the list?
check.output: 你能让 Milo 把牛奶和鸡蛋加到清单上吗？

check.name: wholesale translation
check.source: 呃，那个，我今天下午要去 QBR meeting，就是，可能会 late 一点。Um, 你可以帮我 pick up the parcel 吗？然后，嗯，晚上我们 order pizza 吧。
check.output: I'm going to a QBR meeting this afternoon and may be a bit late.

check.name: one stray Chinese character in English speech is let through
check.source: Tell Milo the deck is ready.
check.output: Tell Milo the deck is ready 好.

check.name: two Chinese characters in English speech are drift
check.source: Tell Milo the deck is ready.
check.output: Tell Milo the deck is ready 好的.

check.name: empty input
words: two known mishearings fixed in mixed speech are spelling fixes, not drift
check.source: 嗯，让 phoebe 看一下 pine wood 的 plan 吧。
check.output: 让 Febe 看一下 Pinewood 的 plan 吧。

check.name: words: the same fix without the word list is drift, as before
check.source: 嗯，让 phoebe 看一下 pine wood 的 plan 吧。
check.output: 让 Febe 看一下 Pinewood 的 plan 吧。

check.name: words: listed words the speaker never said are still drift
check.source: 我们今天下午开会。
check.output: 我们今天下午开会 Milo QBR。

check.name: words: a mishearing written in Chinese characters, fixed, is not a swap
check.source: 我明天要交那个西卓文件。
check.output: 我明天要交 ZDRL 文件。

check.name: words: without the word list, that fix counts as a swap
check.source: 我明天要交那个西卓文件。
check.output: 我明天要交 ZDRL 文件。

check.name: words: unchanged text holding a word and its heard form earns nothing and loses nothing
check.source: 今天聊 Febe 和 Phoebe 的事。
check.output: 今天聊 Febe 和 Phoebe 的事。

check.name: words: the credit is only what changed (one form removed, two words added)
check.source: 我跟 Phoebe 说了明天见。
check.output: 我跟 Febe 说了明天见 Febe。

check.name: words: an uncredited extra listed word still counts toward drift
check.source: 我跟 Phoebe 说了明天见。
check.output: 我跟 Febe 说了明天见 Febe Milo。

check.name: words: a credit never hides a translation (enough English is judged on the transcript as it was)
check.source: the zee drill is good
check.output: ZDRL 好

check.name: words: a listed word inside a longer word is left alone, not masked
check.source: 今天 ZDRL-ready zee drill
check.output: 今天 ZDRL-ready ZDRL

check.name: words: a heard form that is also another listed word goes to the fix in the transcript
check.source: 今天 Phoebe 和 Pine Wood 见面。
check.output: 今天 Febe 和 Pinewood 见面。

check.name: words: a heard form inside a longer word is not a match
check.source: 我跟 Phoebes 说了 pine woods 的事。
check.output: 我跟 Febe 说了 Pinewood 的事。
